name: deepdraft
description: Generate polished technical articles in Markdown with Codex

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs/promises'; for (const directory of ['dist', 'packages/core/dist', 'packages/agent-codex/dist']) await fs.rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @deepdraft/core && npm run build -w @deepdraft/agent-codex
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json
